digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text sync (Cloud ADF + Data Center wiki)
propositions: Cloud Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF through production codec paths, achieving idempotent bidirectional round-trip with 99.65%+ fidelity
Data Center safe Markdown must render as native Jira wiki markup via pandoc without content erosion over repeated passes
Echo-safety layer using per-binding baseline + change-gated SHA must prevent sync loops; unchanged reconciliation passes add zero committed-state entries
Origin-gated outbound must preserve Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) through local→remote updates
Append-only comment-ID map with codec-routed comment creation enables bidirectional comment sync without edit/delete operations
Live Dockerized Jira DC harness must exercise the production cutover, verify rendered HTML via expand=renderedFields, and confirm second-pass convergence
